releases.name: v0.22.0
changes: **Settings Modal** — Centralized settings with 4 tabs (Drawing Aids, Grid & Snap, Display, Units & Scale) accessible from MenuBar and StatusBar
**Block Definitions** — Block definition and block instance support with DXF import/export
**Title Block Editing** — Inline title block field editing with click detection and hover highlights
**Viewport Move** — Keyboard viewport move in sheet mode (G key)
**Pattern Import** — SVG multi-pattern import dialog with grouping and search
**Pattern Manager** — Resizable modal with dynamic preview
**Axis Lock** — Move tool axis lock (X/Y keys) with dynamic input support
**UI Cleanup** — Reordered Quick Access Toolbar, removed POS/LWT/ROT from status bar (moved to Settings)

releases.name: v0.19.0
changes: **Leader annotation tool** with multi-leader support, arrow options, and grip editing
**Text Style Manager** for reusable named text formatting presets
**Bundled Osifont (ISO 3098)** as default font; text sizes now in paper mm
**File format v3** with automatic v2→v3 migration for font/size values
**Section profile labels** in canvas, sheet viewports, and PDF export
**Body-drag move** for selected shapes; Shift+drag proportional edge scaling
**Sheet drawing frame border**, viewport alignment guides, lineweight toggle default OFF
**Inline text editor formatting toolbar** (bold, italic, underline, alignment)
**Standard title block PDF export**, viewport clipping, drawing frame in PDF
**Double-click viewport** to enter drawing; drawing tools disabled in sheet mode
Default 1:100 scale, 10000×10000 boundary, two default sheets, tick-mark dimensions
Fixed text bounds scaling, box selection, clipboard offsets, and dimension settings

releases.name: Open 2D Studio v0.15.0
changes: Grid-based pattern picker with search, categories, favorites, and recently used patterns
Foreground and background pattern layers with independent angle, scale, and color
Named Filled Region Types for reusable pattern configurations with management dialog
Expanded built-in pattern library from 6 to 26 patterns (material, geometric, masonry, etc.)
Enhanced pattern editor with larger preview, template gallery, visual angle picker, and dash presets
Granular draw order controls: Bring Forward and Send Backward in context menu and ribbon
Boundary visibility toggle and inner loop (cutout) support for hatch shapes
Masking toggle for opaque/transparent filled regions
Live canvas preview when hovering patterns in the picker
Save/load support for all new hatch fields with backward compatibility
